subject: Executive intro & sponsor seating — proposed demo window for Veridian
messages:
From: Angela Park <angela.park@veridian.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>; Michael Chen <michael.chen@veridian.com>
Cc: Sarah Yu <sarah.yu@veridian.com>; Chris Lin <chris.lin@veridian.com>
Date: 2029-06-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Demo request — exec intro + product sponsor (Veridian timeline)

Hi Laura,

Thanks for the quick intro yesterday. We’re at the stage where the CIO and VP Engineering want an exec-level walkthrough + a short product deep-dive before we move into procurement (internal goal: decision timeline by end of June). Can you propose a single two-part slot that gets both: a 30–45 minute executive overview for Chris + Sarah, followed immediately by a focused 20–30 minute technical deep-dive for the engineering and architecture team?

Best candidate windows for us (Pacific):
- Mon 17 Jun: 16:00–17:00 PT (Chris is available 16:30–17:30; Sarah can do the full hour)
- Wed 19 Jun: 19:00–20:00 PT (better for APAC attendees)

If you can do a compact format (45/25), that would be ideal. We have a short requirements doc attached and would like the session recorded. Also need an NDA on file before the deep dive — I attached the signed copy we already use internally.

Att: Veridian-requirements.pdf; veridian-nda-signed.pdf

Thanks,
Angela Park
Business Operations, Veridian Health
angela.park@veridian.com
+1 415-555-0183
From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Angela Park <angela.park@veridian.com>
Cc: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>; priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.com>; Michael Chen <michael.chen@veridian.com>
Date: 2029-06-10T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo request — exec intro + product sponsor (Veridian timeline)

Hi Angela — great to hear the timeline. Thanks for sending the requirements and the NDA. I’m looping in Markus (product sponsor) and Priyom (SE) so we can line up the right coverage. Proposal below:

Option A — compact (preferred)
- 17 Jun, 17:00–18:00 PT: 30–40 min exec overview (Markus + Laura) + 20–30 min technical run (Priyom)

Option B — later slot for APAC attendees
- 19 Jun, 19:00–20:00 PT: same split, extend Q&A as needed

Logistics / asks
- Do you need a separate dial-in for finance (Michael mentioned CFO might join for 15 mins)? If so, we’ll include a second line and record both streams.
- We’ll share a short agenda and a lightweight slide pack (attached).
- Can you confirm the attendee list so we tailor the deep-dive?

Att: redwood-exec-preview.pdf

Markus / Priyom — can you confirm coverage for 17 Jun at 17:00 PT? Markus will take the executive portion; Priyom can handle the technical deep-dive and live demo.

Thanks — will hold option A tentatively until EOD tomorrow unless you want us to send a calendar hold now.

—Laura Bennett
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0122
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>; priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.com>; Angela Park <angela.park@veridian.com>
Cc: Michael Chen <michael.chen@veridian.com>
Date: 2029-06-11T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo request — exec intro + product sponsor (Veridian timeline)

Thanks Laura / Angela. I can do an executive overview and highlight the cost/latency/playbook benefits. Small ask on timing: I have a prior commitment that afternoon and would prefer to shift Option A by +60 minutes so the session starts at 17:00 PT and runs 17:00–18:00 PT (i.e., I’d cover 17:00–17:40 for the exec portion, then Priyom takes the technical deep-dive).

If that works for Veridian we’ll prepare a 35–40 minute exec narrative focused on:
- Production economics: throughput & cost controls
- Deployment modes: hosted / dedicated / private tradeoffs
- Rollout & reliability playbook for regulated customers

I’ll attach the product highlights I plan to reference. Priyom — if I start late by a few minutes, can you open the tech portion and kick off the demo?

Att: prod-highlights.pptx

Markus Klein
VP, Product — Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>; markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>; Angela Park <angela.park@veridian.com>
Date: 2029-06-11T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo request — exec intro + product sponsor (Veridian timeline)

On it. I can cover the technical deep-dive and run the live demo starting exactly at 17:40 PT if Markus needs the first 10 minutes to settle in. I’ll bring:
- brief benchmark slide (latency/cost numbers for comparable workloads)
- short QA checklist for security/compliance asks
- a 15-minute live demo focused on inference routing + caching behavior

I’ll be online and can jump in as early as 17:30 PT to take the lead if Markus is delayed. No attachments from my side.

—Priyom
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.com
From: Angela Park <angela.park@veridian.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>; markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>; priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Michael Chen <michael.chen@veridian.com>; Sarah Yu <sarah.yu@veridian.com>; Chris Lin <chris.lin@veridian.com>
Date: 2029-06-12T07:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo request — exec intro + product sponsor (Veridian timeline)

All good — 17 Jun, 17:00–18:00 PT works for us (we’ll plan exec 17:00–17:40, technical 17:40–18:00). Please send a calendar invite with two dial-in options: one general line and a second finance line for Michael and the CFO. Also include a note that the deep dive will be recorded; we’ll opt in/out of the recording for the exec portion.

Quick attendee update: Chris (CIO) confirmed, Sarah (VP Eng) will join for the first 45 minutes, Michael (Finance) will drop in for the final 10 minutes. I’ve attached the requirements and our signed NDA for your records — thanks for holding.

Can you send the official agenda and the calendar invite (with the HubSpot deal link) when you have a moment?

Att: Veridian-requirements.pdf; veridian-nda-signed.pdf

Best,
Angela
